notes: System-level / cross-equipment point dictionary. The sensor-health rules (SYS-FC-054/100/101) bind ROLE POINTS, not canonical equipment points — the documented exception to the canonical-name convention (SCHEMA.md points contract; decided 2026-08-17, _research/fc100-sensor-health-design.md §3). The reference's own SYS-FC-054 card does the same ('varies by application'). The host's instance configuration records which real point each role is bound to; that same record drives the adjudicates NO_EVAL fan-out. Role entries carry brick/s223 null — the semantics belong to whatever the role is bound to. Reference ch.16's other rules (SYS-FC-050..053/055..057) will add their own points when that batch opens.

points.name: sensor_value
points.description: ROLE: the single sensor under adjudication (flatline/spike rules)
points.notes: Role point: bound per instance to any real-valued sensor (temperature, pressure, flow...). Thresholds on the rules that consume it are in the BOUND point's units and MUST be retuned per binding — a 0.1 degC flatline band is nonsense for a Pa sensor. Binding record doubles as the adjudicates target.

points.name: sensor_value_a
points.description: ROLE: primary sensor of a redundancy pair (SYS-FC-054)
points.notes: Role point; the reference's own required-points table for SYS-FC-054 lists sensor_a/sensor_b with 'varies by application'. Pair members must share quantity kind and units at binding.

points.name: sensor_value_b
points.description: ROLE: reference sensor of a redundancy pair (SYS-FC-054)
points.notes: Role point; see sensor_value_a. The pair rule's verdict is `ambiguous` — it cannot name which member drifted.

points.name: equip_active
points.description: ROLE: owning equipment is running/active (gates flatline evaluation)
points.notes: Role point: bound to the owning equipment's run/enable status (sf_status, pump_status, boiler_status...). A flat signal on idle equipment is normal; flatline only accuses the sensor while the process should be moving.
